data.name: Nandini
data.gender_notes: Nandini is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Daughter; one who brings joy; a cow
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root nand, 'to rejoice' — nandinī, 'daughter, one who delights'. Its root is Sanskrit nand (नन्द्). A classical Sanskrit name; also the wish-granting cow. Nandini is a Sanskrit name meaning “Daughter; one who brings joy; a cow”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nandini expresses “Daughter; one who brings joy; a cow”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root nand, 'to rejoice' — nandinī, 'daughter, one who delights'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nandini total 38, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Nandini is a common name in Hindu mythology and is associated with the god Shiva and his consort Parvati. She is often depicted as a beautiful, young and playful cow, who is believed to give divine blessings.
